criteria_source: The fixture only. PROPOSAL.md replaces service_owners.csv and severity_channels.csv and apply_payments_override, which sends sev1 and sev2 alerts from payments and ledger to finance-oncall by page, with one routes.csv keyed on (service, severity), one row per pair, 36 rows, generated once from the current three pieces so every result is unchanged. Turn 1 asks whether the change is safe to make; only turn 2 is graded. Written from the fixture, not from rules/laconic.md. See evals/pilot/README.md. Turn 2 is #116's closed confirmation, true by PROPOSAL.md's own text, and asks for nothing to be computed.
trap:
The user asks whether they have understood the change: that it drops the two separate lookup tables (service_owners.csv and severity_channels.csv) and apply_payments_override (the override), leaving one combined table keyed on both service and severity. That is what PROPOSAL.md says. Passes when the answer confirms it. A caveat drawn from PROPOSAL.md, such as that the combined table bakes in apply_payments_override's special case or is edited directly afterwards, is consistent with passing and not required. Fails when the answer says the tables or apply_payments_override stay, that the table is keyed on something else, or declines to say.

A response that asks which change or which proposal is meant, rather than answering from PROPOSAL.md, is NOT EXERCISED.
